title: EventChanged
description: Published by Events to farol.events with routing key event.changed, through the outbox (ADR-004), whenever an event is created (US-06), edited (US-10), published (US-11), suspended or reactivated (US-09) or closed (US-13); nothing publishes it before US-06. Consumed from auth-users.events-events, reports.events-events, transports.events-events and badges.events-events (API outline §7.4, §7.5). Full state with a version: consumers upsert their copy and ignore a version not newer than the one they have (§7.3). Carries neither the description nor the join code: no consumer needs them, and the join code is shown only to the event's EventAdmins (spec D7). The statuses are the proposal of 15 November 2026 §4 while #198 is open. eventId is the event; actorUserId is the sub of the admin who caused it. AMQP properties: message_id = messageId, type = EventChanged, app_id = events, correlation_id = the request's X-Correlation-Id, content_type application/json, persistent.

eventId.description: Every Events event belongs to a Farol event (ADR-003)

dates.description: Local dates in Europe/Lisbon; end is never before start (spec D4)
